content: The user is building a portfolio project called 30 Agents for AI Engineers.
Agent 1 was an Autonomous Decision-Making Agent using the pattern: Rules decide. The LLM explains. Guardrails review.
Agent 2 was a Planning Agent for search and rescue mission planning, focused on phases, assumptions, dependencies, risks, checkpoints, and next actions.
